    SELECT DISTINCT DATE(insert_date) as insert_date
    FROM cities
    WHERE country_code_2 = 'ir' AND insert_date LIKE '2022-01-%'
    ORDER BY insert_date
),
dated_with_prev AS (
    SELECT 
        insert_date,
        LAG(insert_date) OVER (ORDER BY insert_date) as prev_date
    FROM jan_dates
),
consecutive_groups AS (
    SELECT 
        insert_date,
        SUM(CASE WHEN prev_date IS NULL OR (insert_date - prev_date) > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY insert_date) as grp

),
consecutive_periods AS (
    SELECT 
        grp,
        MIN(insert_date) as start_date,
        MAX(insert_date) as end_date,
        COUNT(*) as num_days
    FROM consecutive_groups
    GROUP BY grp
),
longest_period AS (
    SELECT start_date, end_date
    FROM consecutive_periods
    WHERE num_days = (SELECT MAX(num_days) FROM consecutive_periods)
)

WITH iran_dates AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT 
        c.insert_date,
        CAST(c.insert_date AS DATE) as date_val
    FROM cities c
    JOIN cities_countries cc ON c.country_code_2 = cc.country_code_2
    WHERE cc.country_name = 'iran'
        AND c.insert_date LIKE '2022-01-%'
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        date_val,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY date_val) as rn,
        DATE_TRUNC('day', date_val) as d
    FROM iran_dates
),
consecutive AS (
    SELECT 
        d,
        rn,
        d - (rn - 1) * INTERVAL '1 day' as grp
    FROM ranked
),
grouped AS (
    SELECT 
        grp,
        MIN(d) as start_date,
        MAX(d) as end_date,
        COUNT(*) as days_in_period
    FROM consecutive
    GROUP BY grp
),
longest_period AS (
    SELECT start_date, end_date, days_in_period
    FROM grouped
    WHERE days_in_period = (SELECT MAX(days_in_period) FROM grouped)
)
SELECT 
    lp.start_date,
    lp.end_date,
    lp.days_in_period,
    COUNT(c.city_id) as total_entries,
    SUM(c.capital::INTEGER) as capital_entries,
    ROUND(1.0 * SUM(c.capital::INTEGER) / COUNT(c.city_id), 4) as proportion_capital
FROM longest_period lp
JOIN cities c ON CAST(c.insert_date AS DATE) >= lp.start_date AND CAST(c.insert_date AS DATE) <= lp.end_date
JOIN cities_countries cc ON c.country_code_2 = cc.country_code_2
WHERE cc.country_name = 'iran'
GROUP BY lp.start_date, lp.end_date, lp.days_in_period
